description: Class master screen, reached via fwzz-create-dialog's Create (F5). Opens on the 'Search Terms' tab; Basic Data carries the fields product type 26B (Inv:MF) actually requires - Issuer and Issue Currency - and blocks switching to any other tab until Issuer is filled ('Make an entry in mandatory field "Issuer"'). Tabs present for 26B: Search Terms, Basic Data, Conditions, Exchanges, Security Swap, Regulatory Reporting, User Data - note this is a different set from the empty fwzz-entry screen's tab strip (which also shows 'SPPI' and no 'Security Swap'); tabs are product-type-dependent and were not re-verified beyond 26B.

idNumber.title: Security Class ID Number
idNumber.note: Reads the literal placeholder '\INTERN\' before Save for an internally-numbered product type. The real, server-assigned id is only knowable by reading this field again after Save (or re-Displaying), same rigor TC-011 applies to the Bond Workbench's client-side placeholder.

issuer.title: Issuer Identity Key
issuer.note: Basic Data tab only. Must be a Business Partner in role TR0150 - the field's own F4 returns 0 rows on DS4/100 even with every filter cleared (no BP is set up in that role), so a valid partner has to be known some other way. 700000453 ('TATA FIN PVT.LTD / MUMBAI') is confirmed valid by Check (F8): 'Data is consistent'. 400000003 (a BP used elsewhere in this suite as a plain deal counterparty) is NOT valid here - 'Business partner 400000003 does not exist in role TR0150'. Do not assume any BP number works without a Check first.

issueCurrency.title: Issue Currency
issueCurrency.note: Basic Data tab. Hard-required by Check (F8): 'It is absolutely necessary to enter the issue currency on the Basic Data tab.'

issueStartDate.title: Issue Start Date
issueStartDate.note: Basic Data tab. Set by TC-019 from 2026-08-20 onward at the requester's direction; TC-017 leaves it unset.

nominalValue.title: Nominal Value per Stock (Independent of Currency)
nominalValue.note: Basic Data tab. Set by TC-019 from 2026-08-20 onward at the requester's direction; TC-017 leaves it unset.

checkButton.note: 'Check (F8)'. Validates only - the read-only way this screen's mandatory fields were discovered, never a save.
